title: festuca dalmatica subsp. panciciana
intro: Festuca dalmatica subsp. panciciana, commonly known as Dalmatian grass, is a plant species in the grass family, Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Festuca dalmatica subsp. panciciana include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
